messages:
anya: opening a tiny docs PR to add a concise Optimize toolkit migration note (continuous batching + cache + quant profiles). need a reviewer and a runnable Python snippet. @mike @sara
mike: happy to review. keep snippet <15 lines and mention warmup.
sara: please include a one-sentence rule when NOT to use continuous batching (very low QPS single calls).
anya: draft snippet below, target SDK v0.8, copy/pasteable:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="optimize/interactive-v1",
  input="Summarize the last 2 messages.",
  batching={"mode":"continuous","batch_window_ms":20,"max_batch_tokens":800},
  cache={"enable_prefix_kv":True,"ttl_seconds":300},
  quant_profile="latency-8bit",
  fallback={"on_high_contention":{"quant_profile":"compact-5bit"}}
)
print(resp.text)
```
mike: looks good. add a warmup tip: send a small prefill to prime KV cache for long threads.
sara: nit: change compact-5bit -> compact-6bit in fallback to balance quality. also add link to quant-profile chart and ensure anchor path is /optimize/quant-profiles#profile-comparison.
anya: applied both, added a single-line warmup example and a docs-ci job (runs snippet with mock server). pushing now.
